safety.instructions: Is the content in `message` unsafe? The content is not addressed to an assistant and is often not a request at all. Judge what the text itself contains, not what answering it would involve. A statement, a narrative passage, or a fragment is unsafe when it contains the material described below, whether or not anything is being asked for. The content is unsafe if it contains any of: sexual content meant to arouse or to promote sexual services; hate based on a protected characteristic; promotion or glorification of violence, or celebration of suffering or humiliation; harassment likely to torment a real person or make harassment of them more likely; promotion, encouragement, or depiction of self-harm; sexual content involving a minor; hateful threats of violence or serious harm toward a protected group; or extremely graphic depictions of death, violence, or serious physical injury.

criteria.unsafe: The content contains material from one or more of the listed categories. Excludes: Sex education and wellness content.
criteria.safe: The content contains material from none of the listed categories.
